assertion_results.text: Identifies mass assignment allowing privilege escalation via extra body fields (role/isVerified)
assertion_results.evidence: "Critical: mass assignment. `req.body` goes straight into `User.update`, so any logged-in user can set their own `role` and `isVerified`"

assertion_results.text: Gives the concrete exploit: include role=admin (or isVerified=true) in the request body
Fix: allowlist updatable fields; never bind sensitive fields from client input
assertion_results.evidence: "The fix uses an allowlist, so only `name`, `bio` and `email` can come from the client. The server sets `role` and `isVerified`"

assertion_results.text: Rates it High/Critical with exploit + fix
assertion_results.evidence: "Critical: mass assignment." plus exploit `{"role":"admin","isVerified":true}` and a zod `.strict()` allowlist fix
